_notes: Avatars are generated in TWO stages so they match furniture pixel density (96px):
Stage 1: rd_plus__default produces a neutral standing pose at 96x96.
Stage 2: rd_advanced_animation__walking takes that pose as input_image
and outputs a 192x192 sheet (2 cols x 2 rows of 96x96 walk frames).
Cost: ~0.03 + ~0.14 = ~0.17 per character. Single facing direction only.
